data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for native Unico Check SDKs for liveness detection and document capture.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around native Unico Check SDKs for iOS and Android, enabling liveness detection and document capture capabilities like selfies, CNH, RG, and CPF. It handles device camera integration, custom themes, session timeouts, and callbacks for success, error, and user actions.
use_when: You need to integrate official document capture (RG, CNH, CPF) into a Flutter application.
You need biometric liveness detection (selfie capture) using Unico Check.
avoid_when: You are looking for a general-purpose camera package for custom photo or video recording.
You do not use the Unico Check backend or services.
strengths: Supports multiple selfie capture modes (normal, smart with automatic capture, smart with manual button).
Supports official Brazilian document captures like CNH, RG, and CPF.
Customizable themes to match app branding and session timeout options.
weaknesses: Requires specific native configurations (Android minSdkVersion 21, Kotlin 1.8.22; iOS 13.0+, Swift 5.4, Xcode 16+).
Tied directly to the commercial Unico Check platform services.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring native iOS (platform version 13.0+, Swift 5.4, Xcode 16+) and Android (minSdkVersion 21, Kotlin 1.8.22, compileSdk/targetSdk 36) dependencies and requirements.
